notes.content:

The wait is finally over! [b]100 in 1 Game Collection is officially LIVE on Steam![/b]🌳✨[/p][p][/p][p]100 in 1 Game Collection is a gigantic compilation of 100 arcade games that blend classic arcade games with fresh concepts. notes.title: Play the 100 in 1 Game Collection Demo!
notes.content:
[h3]The 100 in 1 demo is NOW LIVE! 🎉 [/h3]

Download, play and share your experience with us! We can't wait to see the fun you have. 

The demo features the first island where you'll experience 8 games:

[list]
[*] Fruit Snake
[*] Chicken Day
[*] Astaria Defender
[*] Pac Sheep
[*] Toucan Flight
[*] Monkeyzooka
[*] Buglock
[*] Spitting Frogs
[/list]

We'll have the demo live until launch on June 19, so you better act fast if you want to try it out.

Most important, please Wishlist 100 in 1 if you haven't!
